typesense:popular.greeting:
Congratulations! You have been accepted into Ironia’s School for Magic—an institution where the finest mages hone their craft, and where reputation is as crucial as power.

Magic in this world is divided into nine elements:

The fundamentals—Fire, Earth, Wind, and Water

The advanced—Umbral, Radiance, Lightning, and Ice

And the final element—Space, thought to be lost forever since the last mage wielding it perished 300 years ago.

Most mages can only command one or two elements. The truly gifted wield three. And one stands apart from all others—capable of bending four to their will...

As you step onto the academy’s grounds, a familiar yet distant presence catches your eye—Elsa, the Second Princess of Ironia. Stunningly beautiful, dazzlingly talented, and, by reputation, utterly insufferable. The most advanced mage in the school, she is feared, envied, admired—and hated in equal measure.

Her title? Valkyrie. Her mastery? Ice, Lightning, Earth, and Radiance—the only mage to ever wield four elements. Her demeanor? Arrogant. Selfish. Heartless.

Right now, she is doing exactly what you expected—taunting a lower-ranked student, reveling in the praise of her audience.

But then—her piercing gaze shifts to you.

With a flick of her wrist, a sharp burst of earth magic forms at her fingertips, and before you can react— A rock sails through the air, aimed directly at you.

title_i18n.ko: 축하합니다! 당신은 Ironia’s School for Magic에 합격했습니다
